title: Auxiliary Machine Configuration
statement: Let $M$ be a finite Turing machine over the Boolean alphabet, let $y$ be its input, let $s$ be a state of the tabulating machine built from $M$, and let $p$ be an input-head position among the $|y|+2$ positions flanking the input. Choose three integer-indexed Boolean tapes $\tau_0,\tau_1,\tau_2$, their head positions $z_0,z_1,z_2\in\mathbb Z$, and an output list. The resulting configuration has state $s$, input-head position $p$, blank contents and zero head positions on the original work tapes, and the chosen contents, head positions, and output on the three auxiliary tapes and output tape.
hypotheses_covered: A finite Turing machine $M$ over the Boolean alphabet
